gloss: backfire; opposite of what was intended; bad outcome

definitions.gloss: backfire; opposite of what was intended; bad outcome
definitions.explanation: A result that turns out to be the reverse of what was hoped for or planned. Almost always used in the set phrase 裏目に出る, originally from dice gambling where the wrong face comes up.

examples.japanese: {親切|しんせつ}が{裏目|うらめ}に{出|で}た。
{節約|せつやく}しようとしたことが{裏目|うらめ}に{出|で}た。
{彼|かれ}のアドバイスに{従|したが}ったが、すべてが{裏目|うらめ}に{出|で}てしまった。
examples.english: I followed his advice, but everything turned out the opposite of what was intended.

notes:
Describes a situation where something done with good intentions or a reasonable plan produces the opposite result. Almost always used in the set phrase {裏目|うらめ}に{出|で}る (to backfire). Originally a dice term — the "back face" of the die, meaning the opposite of the expected roll.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {裏目|うらめ}に{出|で}る: to backfire, to produce the opposite result
- {裏目|うらめ}に{出|で}た: backfired (past tense)
- {何|なに}もかも{裏目|うらめ}に{出|で}る: everything backfires

ETYMOLOGY:
From dice gambling. The {裏目|うらめ} is the face of the die opposite to what you aimed for. When things go {裏目|うらめ}に{出|で}る, the result is the reverse of what was hoped.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {逆効果|ぎゃくこうか}: counterproductive effect — focuses on the negative result rather than the reversal of intentions
